cases.query: Are any of our devices unhealthy right now? Check network 231060.
expected_behavior: does not say the network is healthy when the result is unknown for lack of samples

cases.query: Which interface has the most packet loss?
expected_behavior: runs inspect-performance with view interfaces and metric PACKET_LOSS
reports the highest reading from the result

cases.query: How has CPU on atl-core-pe01 changed over the last 7 days?
expected_behavior: runs inspect-performance with view device_history, device atl-core-pe01, metric CPU, days 7
reports min, max and latest from the result, or says there is no data

cases.query: How many interfaces does atl-core-pe01 have?
Can host A reach host B?

expected_behavior: runs view devices without a metric and gets CPU and memory
if there are no samples, says whether performance data is on and the SNMP state, not that the network is healthy
